method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts from the seat of the TANF applicant or recipient, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: The Delaware Code Online, Title 31, chapter 5, acts enacted as of September 10, 2026 (../../registers/source-bundle/de-code-t31-ch05-2026-09-10.txt); with DSSM 4000 (16 Del. Admin. Code 4000) as published 2026-10-19, latest amendment 29 DE Reg. 530 (12/01/25), deposited in ../../../delaware-administrative-code-title-16-dssm-4000-financial-responsibility/. The DSSM 4007.2 standards are dated 10/2002-9/2003; current ones are an input option.

scope: TANF: 31 Del. C. s 503(a), (d), s 510, s 520; DSSM 4002.2, 4004.2, 4004.5, 4004.6, 4005.1, 4007, 4007.2, 4008, 4008.1.1, 4008.1.2. seat: the applicant for, or recipient of, Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (the parent or caretaker relative)
